items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation

items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.

summaries.zh: OpenAI和Hugging Face就AI模型评估期间发生的安全事件分享了早期发现，指出高级网络能力并为防御者提供经验教训。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, revealing advanced cyber capabilities. The collaboration aims to provide insights for defense strategies. The incident underscored the need for robust security measures in AI development. Both companies emphasized the importance of transparency and shared knowledge to mitigate risks. The findings contribute to the broader understanding of threats in AI model testing.
